text.arabic_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

words.gloss_range: enter or undergo the already known fire as a direct command; the attached object suffix keeps the fire present without renaming it
words.root_gloss_range: heat-contact and fire-exposure range, with disputed prayer or closeness associations retained only as contrastive pressure here
words.prose: {{ar:ٱصْلَوْهَا}} ({{tr:iṣlawhā}}) is a complete one-word sentencing beat: the attached feminine object points back to the already known fire, so the command does not introduce a new object or leave the verb floating. The selected root pressure is bodily exposure to fire; prayer-adjacent or voluntary-warming associations survive only as a hostile contrast, not as the local sense. Because the ayah opens with this imperative before explanation, the reader feels the scene move from disputed perception to imposed contact.

topics.headline: attached pronoun points to the known fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire is not renamed; it is treated as already known and made the direct object of the command.
topics.reason: The attached feminine singular object suffix is syntactically forced and resolves to the previously introduced fire, keeping the addressees distinct from the object.

topics.headline: heat contact selected from the root field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels punishment as forced contact with fire, while broader prayer or warmth associations remain only contrastive pressure.
topics.reason: The local Form I imperative with a fire object selects entering or undergoing fire; causative, voluntary warming, and prayer-adjacent associations do not replace that selected sense.

topics.headline: one-word command opens as verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with a direct sentencing command before any explanation is offered.
topics.reason: The first word is a complete imperative clause with its object suffix, making the opening beat a verdict rather than a report.

topics.headline: rare fire-entry imperative formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command as an entry-verdict formula rather than a routine description of burning.
topics.reason: Distributional rows present this imperative as a marked eschatological command form, coherent with the local scene of entry into punishment.

topics.headline: question gives way to physical sentencing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from disputing the fire's reality to being commanded into it.
topics.reason: The opening imperative answers the prior challenge by moving from perception and questioning to direct exposure.

topics.headline: sound texture binds opening to the response beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the opening fire command feeding the repeated emphatic and sibilant texture of the patience and equality sequence.
topics.reason: The sound rows give a concrete local pattern across the opening command, the two patience forms, and the equality predicate; this is a secondary but coherent payoff.

words.gloss_range: sequential and consequential connector making the next command follow from the fire-entry command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) makes the patience command depend on the fire-entry command. It can be heard as both then and therefore: endurance is the next response-space after punishment is already imposed, not a fresh way out. Its attachment to the following verb also makes the shift into the futility beat feel continuous rather than restarted.

topics.headline: connector makes patience consequent on fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that endurance is not an independent remedy; it follows as the consequence-space after entry into fire.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the first imperative to the second, allowing both sequential and causal force in the local clause relation.

topics.headline: attached connector audibly pivots the beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition into the patience command as a joined movement, not a full restart.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector is visibly and audibly attached to the following command and marks the shift from verdict to futility.

words.gloss_range: endure or restrain yourselves as the positive pole of a response binary, with the command force made ironic by the following equality verdict
words.root_gloss_range: patience, endurance, restraint, and binding-like pressure; broader derived forms of competitive or intensified endurance are not selected here
words.prose: {{ar:ٱصْبِرُوا}} ({{tr:iṣbirū}}) sounds like direct counsel, but here it opens the positive half of an X/not-X frame that will be leveled. The root pressure is self-restraint under duress, made bitter by the fire context; the Form I imperative does not ask for competitive or intensified endurance. Its repeated sounds also connect failed perception at the boundary with the now-futile demand to endure.

topics.headline: imperative opens the X/not-X pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to endure is staged mainly to form the positive half of a binary that will be collapsed.
topics.reason: The imperative is coordinated with its negated counterpart and then evaluated by the equality predicate.

topics.headline: direct command emptied by the next verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the bitter irony of counsel that sounds like a command but is immediately declared outcome-irrelevant.
topics.reason: The surface is a 2mp imperative, but the following equality statement removes its capacity to change the outcome.

topics.headline: root image of restraint under duress
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees patience here as self-restraint inside imposed fire, while other derived endurance intensities are not selected by the Form I imperative.
topics.reason: The local sense remains enduring or restraining oneself; binding and bitterness sharpen that sense but do not replace it with another action.

topics.headline: same patience form reversed from consolation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a form often used for real counsel is turned here into futile endurance under recompense.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels make the same imperative recognizable, while the local fire and equality frame invert its ordinary consoling force.

topics.headline: failed seeing hands off to futile endurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the near-mirror from failed seeing to futile endurance across the ayah boundary.
topics.reason: The sound rows point to a concrete b/ṣ reversal and repeated ṣ-b-r texture; it remains a secondary acoustic payoff.

words.gloss_range: controlled disjunction that sets endurance and non-endurance as alternatives only to have them equalized
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:ʾaw}}) does not create meaningful escape. It opens a complete alternative set, endure or do not endure, so that the following equality predicate can cover the whole response field. The short particle is the audible hinge where the command turns toward its negated counterpart.

topics.headline: or opens a complete alternative set
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle builds a full endurance-or-non-endurance field before that field is made equal.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the positive command with its negated counterpart, giving the equality predicate both branches to govern.

topics.headline: apparent choice becomes equivalence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees apparent choice being repurposed as rhetorical indifference, not genuine agency.
topics.reason: The following equality phrase makes the disjunction a setup for equivalence rather than an open option.

topics.headline: short particle marks the turn to negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short turn between two longer patience forms before the verdict collapses them.
topics.reason: The independent particle separates the two branches and gives the binary an audible hinge.

words.gloss_range: negative particle scoped to the following patience verb, creating the direct not-enduring pole of the binary
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is narrow and decisive: it negates the following patience verb, not the whole earlier command. That creates the not-X side of the frame, so the ayah tests endurance against its direct absence. A prohibitive edge can be heard, but the equality verdict absorbs it into indifference rather than making non-endurance a useful instruction.

topics.headline: negation scopes over the second patience verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that negation creates the second pole of the pair without undoing the whole clause.
topics.reason: The negative particle governs the following verb and stays inside the coordinated alternative.

topics.headline: not-patience completes the logical field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contrast is not patience versus another virtue but patience versus its direct absence.
topics.reason: The particle supplies the not-X branch required for the disjunction to become exhaustive.

topics.headline: prohibitive sound is absorbed into indifference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a possible prohibitive edge, while the following equality prevents it from becoming a real instruction with practical force.
topics.reason: The local grammar allows a prohibitive or negative feel, but the equality statement makes the force rhetorical rather than outcome-changing.

words.gloss_range: negated jussive patience verb, the governed not-enduring pole addressed to the same group
words.root_gloss_range: patience, endurance, and restraint; here the same root is reversed under negation to mark failed restraint

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative particle governing the following patience verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَصْبِرُوا}} ({{tr:taṣbirū}}) completes the negative branch. Governed by {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), it is not a free second command but the not-enduring pole addressed to the same group. The restraint image survives in reverse: failed self-restraint is tested beside endurance, and both are handed directly to the equality verdict before the past-deed explanation takes over.

topics.headline: jussive verb completes the negated branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second patience form is grammatically controlled by negation and completes the branch before equality lands.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive after the negator and is the last verbal option before the equality predicate.

topics.headline: same group occupies both response options
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one addressed group presented with both endurance and non-endurance, not two different audiences.
topics.reason: Both patience verbs carry the same 2mp addressee and the same root, with polarity changed by the negator.

topics.headline: negation reverses the restraint image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels failed self-restraint as the exact counterpart to endurance, while both responses remain equally ineffective in the fire scene.
topics.reason: The root sense of endurance or restraint remains present under negation; it is reversed rather than replaced by a new action.

topics.headline: present endurance is subordinated to past-state judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present non-endurance, like endurance, is made irrelevant by the later past-deed explanation.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from the negated patience verb into equality and then into the final past-state recompense clause.

topics.headline: root reprise feeds the equality verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same patience root return under negation and carry the line into the equality word.
topics.reason: The acoustic rows identify a concrete reprise of the patience sounds and their handoff to the equality predicate.

words.gloss_range: equality or sameness as the verdict over endurance and non-endurance, made general by the nominal predicate form
words.root_gloss_range: equality, levelness, making even, fashioning, and establishment; here the equality branch is selected with leveling pressure
words.prose: {{ar:سَوَآءٌ}} ({{tr:sawāʾun}}) is the word that levels the binary. As a nominal predicate, it declares the two responses already equal rather than narrating a new act of equalizing. The root's levelness pressure makes the abstract verdict feel like a flattening of difference, and the following burden phrase assigns that sameness to the addressees. The familiar sealed-response formula is narrowed here to patience and non-patience inside fire, with the sound of the repeated patience forms stopping at the equality word.

topics.headline: predicate levels the disjunction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the X/not-X pair being judged equal rather than left as a real choice.
topics.reason: The nominative abstract noun functions as the predicate over the compressed patience-or-non-patience material.

topics.headline: physical levelness colors abstract sameness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the two responses flattened into one outcome, while creation or establishment branches are not locally selected.
topics.reason: The local noun selects equality or sameness; the broader root field contributes leveling pressure without activating unrelated branches as the local sense.

topics.headline: equality is assigned to the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sameness is not abstract; it lands upon the addressed group as their verdict.
topics.reason: The following prepositional phrase completes the equality formula and identifies the addressees as the bearers of the verdict.

topics.headline: Quranic sameness formula becomes afterlife futility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a sealed-response formula now applied to patience and non-patience inside fire.
topics.reason: The recurrence evidence supports a formulaic irreversible-equivalence use, locally narrowed to the afterlife response-space.

topics.headline: sound arrests the binary at equality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated patience sounds stop at the equality word, reinforcing the collapse of difference.
topics.reason: The acoustic rows give a concrete local payoff in the sibilant and glottal landing of the equality verdict.

words.gloss_range: upon you or against you as the bearer phrase that places the equality verdict on the addressed group
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْكُمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalaykum}}) makes the equality verdict adverse and personal. The phrase is not a benefit-for-you expression; it places sameness upon the addressees as a burden. Its suffix continues the same direct-address chain from the commands and points forward to the same group in the past-state explanation.

topics.headline: upon-you marks adverse burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that equality is imposed upon the addressees as a burden, not offered as neutral information or benefit.
topics.reason: The preposition carries upon, incumbent, and adverse pressure in a verdict context, contrasting with a beneficial for-phrase.

topics.headline: suffix keeps the same deniers under the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same addressed group from command to burden to past-state explanation.
topics.reason: The 2mp suffix continues the addressee chain and later echoes in the past-state clause.

topics.headline: postposed phrase completes the equality verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels equality land first and then settle specifically on them.
topics.reason: The word follows the equality predicate and completes Beat 2 by naming who bears the verdict.

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle meaning only or nothing but, opening the explanation that recompense is limited to prior deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative pronoun opening the comprehensive deed object

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:ʾinnamā}}) opens the final causal seal and restricts the explanation: only what they used to do is being recompensed. The surface can be felt as compressed assertion plus limiter, but the local structure resolves it as a restrictive particle. Its embedded mā sound prepares for the later relative {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), so exclusion and comprehensive deed scope are heard in the same closing movement. The compressed sound and position after the equality verdict make the explanation close down debate rather than reopen it.

topics.headline: only past deeds explain the recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cause of punishment is restricted to their own past deeds, excluding present endurance as a causal lever.
topics.reason: The restrictive particle scopes over the passive recompense and its relative deed object.

topics.headline: fused restriction with analyzable components
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees assertion and restriction compressed in one surface, while the local structure resolves the phrase toward restrictive force.
topics.reason: The input notes alternate segmentation pressure, but the local causal seal and QAC grammar support the fused restrictive particle reading.

topics.headline: particle opens the causal seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from command and futility into a closed explanation.
topics.reason: The word begins the explanatory clause that grounds the equality verdict in recompense for deeds.

topics.headline: limiter sound anticipates the relative object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the limiter prepare for the later relative object, joining exclusion with comprehensive deed scope.
topics.reason: The repeated mā element carries different grammatical forces in the local seal: restriction first, relative object later.

topics.headline: questioning resolves into forceful declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the causal explanation close down debate with compressed restrictive force.
topics.reason: The boundary and sound rows cohere with the restrictive particle's role in replacing interrogation with declaration.

words.gloss_range: you are being recompensed or requited, in passive voice, with the deed clause supplying the measure of return
words.root_gloss_range: supplied recompense field with j-z-y requital and j-z-z cutting-to-measure pressure; local sense remains passive requital, not literal cutting
words.prose: {{ar:تُجْزَوْنَ}} ({{tr:tujzawna}}) shifts the addressees from commanded agents into passive recipients. The agent of recompense is syntactically unspoken, while the relative deed clause immediately supplies the measure. The root evidence lets the requital feel calibrated, cut to what was done, but the local verb remains passive recompense rather than a literal cutting act; it also belongs to a recognizable judgment formula, with a reward-side counterpart later in the surah (52:19). Its sharper consonant texture gives the judgment mechanism its own audible edge inside the final seal.

topics.headline: passive foregrounds recipients and deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the addressees have moved from commanded responders to passive recipients of recompense.
topics.reason: The verb is 2mp passive, suppressing the recompensing agent and foregrounding the recipients under judgment.

topics.headline: verb links restriction to the deed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees recompense immediately tied to the relative deed clause rather than left unspecified.
topics.reason: The passive verb takes the relative object clause and sits between the limiter and the deed record.

topics.headline: requital felt as calibrated return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the punishment as measured requital matched to deeds, while the cutting image remains supporting pressure rather than a separate local action.
topics.reason: The local verb means recompensed or requited; the supplied j-z-y and j-z-z convergence can color exact measure but does not replace recompense with literal cutting.

topics.headline: formulaic passive recompense seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a repeated judgment formula, not an isolated wording.
topics.reason: The supplied references identify the passive recompense plus deed clause as a recurring punishment or recompense seal.

topics.headline: same-surah reward pole answers the punishment pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negative recompense here anticipate the reward-side counterpart later in the surah (52:19).
topics.reason: The same-surah echo is concrete and coherent: 52:16 sets the punishment pole that 52:19 answers on the reward side.

topics.headline: active agents become passive recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a role reversal: present agency is stripped away while past agency remains the cause.
topics.reason: The ayah's voice pattern moves from active commands to passive recompense and then to active past deeds.

topics.headline: sharp consonants mark the judgment mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the recompense verb cut into the final seal with a sharper consonant texture.
topics.reason: The sound row provides a small but distinct acoustic payoff tied to the judgment verb.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun meaning what or whatever, opening the comprehensive deed object of recompense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: restrictive particle introducing the causal seal

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the object field of recompense as whatever they used to do. It does not name a single deed class, so the scope stays comprehensive. As a relative pronoun, it bridges passive return to active past action, and its echo with the mā inside {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:ʾinnamā}}) shifts from restriction to deed-object force.

topics.headline: whatever opens the deed field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of recompense is not one named deed but the full open field of what they used to do.
topics.reason: The word is parsed as a relative pronoun introducing the content object of recompense.

topics.headline: relative pronoun bridges passive return and active past
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hinge from what is received now to what was actively done before.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun links the passive recompense verb to the auxiliary-plus-action clause.

topics.headline: relative object avoids blurring deed content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps a concrete deed-object field in view rather than reducing the clause to abstract doing.
topics.reason: The following auxiliary and verb support relative-pronoun parsing here; other mā values do not govern this local slot.

topics.headline: same sound shifts from restriction to relative object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a local echo where mā first restricts and then names the comprehensive deed object.
topics.reason: The repeated element has different grammatical force in the two positions, linking exclusion to the deed field.

words.gloss_range: you were, as an auxiliary forming habitual past with the following deed verb and carrying the same addressees into the explanation
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, and forming a state; here realized as an auxiliary that frames repeated past action
words.prose: {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}) locks the explanation into habitual past. With the following imperfect predicate, it says the recompense answers what they used to be doing, not a single moment and not their present reaction in the fire. The root's being-state pressure survives locally because their past state is characterized by deeds, and the same formula later anchors the reward-side contrast in the surah (52:19).

topics.headline: auxiliary plus imperfect forms past habit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense answers a repeated past pattern, not one isolated moment or present reaction.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary governs the following imperfect predicate and creates a habitual-past construction.

topics.headline: being-state is characterized by deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their past being described as a state of doing, while the auxiliary remains grammatically dependent on the predicate.
topics.reason: The existential root pressure is locally realized through the auxiliary construction with the deed predicate, not as an independent content verb.

topics.headline: same group carried into the explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same addressed group from the burden of equality into the past-deed cause.
topics.reason: The 2mp ending continues the addressee chain and echoes the prior pronoun suffix.

topics.headline: formula grounds the whole ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing formula supplies the reason the present choice cannot change the outcome.
topics.reason: The final auxiliary-plus-deed clause resolves the command and futility sequence by pointing to the established past pattern.

topics.headline: same formula spans punishment and reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same deed formula anchor both punishment here and reward later in the surah (52:19).
topics.reason: The same-surah evidence gives a concrete mirror between 52:16 and 52:19.

words.gloss_range: you used to do or work, as the habitual-past deed predicate that supplies the basis of recompense
words.root_gloss_range: doing, working, producing, and accountable action; local Form I keeps direct performed deeds rather than derived employment senses

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: auxiliary forming habitual past with the deed verb

words.prose: {{ar:تَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:taʿmalūn}}) lands the ayah on human deed-production. Under {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}), it is repeated past doing, and the relative object already supplies the field of what was done. The root pressure makes those deeds feel like purposeful accountable labor, not accidental motion, while reported prefix-vowel variation changes sound without changing the grammar. The final position turns fire, patience, and futility back toward the active deeds that explain passive recompense.

topics.headline: active deed verb explains passive recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reversal: they now receive passively what they actively produced before.
topics.reason: The final active verb stands in contrast with the passive recompense verb and supplies the deed basis of return.

topics.headline: imperfect completes the past-habit construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deeds as repeated past conduct, not one punctual act.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is the predicate governed by the perfect auxiliary.

topics.headline: object field supplied by the relative pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final verb compressed into the relative construction: what they did is already the object field.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun supplies the object field, so the final verb does not need a separate overt object.

topics.headline: deeds as purposeful production
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the deeds as accountable produced labor, while derived employment forms are not selected locally.
topics.reason: The local Form I verb means doing or working; labor and production pressure sharpen accountability but do not import derived employment senses.

topics.headline: prefix-vowel variant leaves syntax intact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notes recitational sound variation without changing the deed-accounting mechanism.
topics.reason: The reported variant changes prefix vowel quality while preserving person, root, and syntactic role.

topics.headline: final verb lands the ayah on deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes not with fire or patience but with human action as the explanatory key.
topics.reason: The final position and formulaic phrase make deed-accounting the closure of the whole sequence.

topics.headline: deed root spans punishment and reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same deed measure connect punishment here with reward-side scenes later in the surah (52:19; 52:21).
topics.reason: The same-surah evidence gives concrete reward-side references where the deed root returns.

topics.headline: failed perception closes as accounted action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the ayah boundary resolve failed perception into accountable action.
topics.reason: The closing sound and boundary rows connect the prior perception question with the final deed-accounting verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1-12 join fire-entry, patience and non-patience, equality, recompense, and prior work.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entry places the addressees inside the consequence. The positive and negative patience commands exhaust the responses, equality neutralizes their power over the result, and matching recompense ties that result to intentional past action. The responses can differ inwardly while remaining causally equal at this stage.

activation_trace.role: Encountering and being made to enter fire supplies the consequence already underway.
Self-restraint from panic supplies one response, repeated positively and under negation.
Equality marks the result as invariant under either response.
Act-matching recompense supplies the reciprocal link between consequence and deed.
Intentional doing supplies the accountable causal input.

changed_reading.before: The ayah commands endurance during punishment.
changed_reading.after: It stages a closed response test: endurance and refusal differ inwardly but neither renegotiates a requital already matched to intentional work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at words 9-12 recompenses what the addressees used to work.
baseline_models.mechanism: Debt collection, labor pay, and past predication form an account-settlement model. A completed working history has matured into what is now collected or paid out; present composure is not new tender that changes the balance.

activation_trace.role: Collecting a debt makes recompense an account coming due.
Pay for work turns the consequence into the dark wage of prior labor.
Past predication gathers repeated doing into an antecedent period now settled.
Equivalence blocks either current response from altering the payable amount.

changed_reading.before: Punishment follows deeds in a general moral sense.
changed_reading.after: The verse sounds like settlement of accrued work: the account is payable, and patience or refusal is not a new payment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1 and 6 place fire exposure beside a root carrying straightness and completed form.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fire branch includes heating and turning a stick until straight, while equality also carries straightness and sound completion. With matching recompense, punishment can image a terrible material leveling in which prior work determines the shape made manifest. This need not imply rehabilitation.

activation_trace.role: Kindling, roasting, and fire-straightening supply heat as an active material process.
Straightness and completed form let equality suggest leveling or making correspond.
Act-matching recompense constrains the image to fitting consequence rather than arbitrary change.
Inescapable severity supplies the closed conditions of the leveling.

changed_reading.after: The fire can also image a dreadful straightening in which consequence is made to fit the shape of prior work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative of entry and the patience/no-patience equality at words 1-6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped branch turns the initial root into a set snare, while patience branches add compelled detention and inescapable crisis. Entry is also capture: once caught, the remaining binary governs bearing the enclosure, not leaving it.

activation_trace.role: The set snare supplies capture as a secondary image for entry.
Compelled holding supplies detention independent of willing endurance.
Trouble with no outlet makes the alternatives choices inside confinement rather than exits.
Equality closes both response paths onto the same captured state.

changed_reading.before: The addressees choose whether to endure an external pain.
changed_reading.after: They are already caught; the remaining choice is how to inhabit a confinement whose exit has closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Binding inscription, an ordered written line, written parchment, and an opened document activate a published-account mechanism. Prior work passes from action into an inspectable record and from record into settlement.

activation_trace.role: Debt collection anchors the focus side of the account coming due.
Labor pay supplies the work-to-return relation.
Inscription establishing an obligating judgment supplies binding force.
An aligned written row supplies ordered inscription.
Written parchment supplies the material bearer of the account.
An opened written document makes the account exposed for execution.

structural_cues: 52:2-3 moves from a written book to writing displayed on an opened sheet before punishment.
52:41 returns to writing as a contested capacity, associating inscription with authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding writing, ordered inscription, parchment, opening, and focus debt/wage branches; I infer that the record carries accountable work into sentence. It may instead be only an oath-object, not a personal ledger.

changed_reading.before: Work-settlement is an economic metaphor generated inside the focus.
changed_reading.after: Settlement gains an archival stage: deeds become a binding, exposed account before their return is collected.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sea whose inventory includes being kindled enlarges the focus's fire-straightening image. Heat belongs to a world where ordinary elements become fuel and stable structures move, not only to an enclosed penal object.

activation_trace.role: Fire-straightening anchors the focus as an active thermal process.
Straightness and completion supply the process's leveling endpoint.
Kindling the sea supplies the elemental scale of the thermal regime.

structural_cues: The raised roof and sea of 52:5-6 precede the sky's convulsion and mountains' movement in 52:9-10.
The explicit fire at 52:14 lets the earlier elemental image prepare rather than replace its referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a kindled-sea branch and cosmic motion; I infer continuity with the focus's fire process. The sea may instead be an independent oath sign.

changed_reading.before: Fire-straightening is a local analogy for individual punishment.
changed_reading.after: It sits inside a cosmic furnace in which stable elements are converted and leveled before explicit fire-entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punishment is a severe event that has fallen, has no remover, and culminates in forceful shoving. Thus equality concerns the power of patience or refusal to deflect the arrived result, not moral or affective identity between the responses.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint remains a distinct inward posture needing explanation.
Equality supplies the invariant, localized to causal efficacy.
A severe descending event supplies an outcome already arriving.
Removing harm is unavailable, defining the dimension on which responses are equal.
Forceful pushing supplies compulsion overwhelming either posture.

structural_cues: 52:7 asserts occurrence and 52:8 immediately negates a defender.
52:13 doubles the force construction before 52:16 presents the alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, non-deflection, force, restraint, and equality; I assign equality to outcome-changing efficacy. Total rhetorical flattening of every difference remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Equality may erase every distinction between patience and impatience.
changed_reading.after: It erases their ability to repel sentence while leaving inward and moral difference intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial of fire is followed by questions about deceptive appearance and failed sight, then the command to encounter fire. An object kept at the level of false report or visual trick becomes unavoidable bodily contact.

activation_trace.role: Fire encounter supplies bodily contact as the epistemic endpoint.
Contradicting truth supplies the prior refusal overturned by contact.
Kindled fire identifies the denied object immediately before entry.
Diversion and deception supply the attempted explanation reducing fire to a trick.
Physical sight supplies the challenged channel that encounter supersedes.

structural_cues: 52:14 points to this fire; 52:15 asks whether it is deception or failed seeing; 52:16 commands entry.
The sequence shifts from speech and sight to forced proximity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, named fire, deception, sight, and contact; I infer that contact closes redescription of evidence. The alternative is pure taunt without a distinct epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The imperative only moves bodies into a place.
changed_reading.after: It converts denied report into inescapable verification: what was called false or deceptive is known by contact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The protected group inhabits good condition and eats and drinks by the same 'what you used to do' construction. Past work can issue in protected enjoyment or fire, making the focus one side of a reciprocal polarity mirror.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense supplies the common return mechanism.
Intentional work supplies the negative side's causal input.
Good condition and blessing supply the positive output.
Repelling harm by protection opposes the focus's non-deflectable state.
Intentional work recurs in the positive formula, making the outcomes comparable.
Labor pay makes enjoyment the bright counterpart of the focus's dark wage.

structural_cues: 52:16 and 52:19 repeat the work-history construction across the fire/garden boundary.
52:18 supplies protection from the punishment that 52:16 declares non-negotiable after entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated causal wording, opposite environments, protection, and work/pay branches; I infer a deliberate polarity mirror. Simple juxtaposition remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The deed formula explains punishment in isolation.
changed_reading.after: It is the negative half of a mirrored return: the same work-history syntax opens onto protected enjoyment or non-deflectable fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Individual acquisition is held as collateral, yet descendants catch up without diminution, and favor includes release without exchange alongside mercy. The ledger governs personal liability without exhausting every good received; the focus's exclusivity can mark non-excess in punishment rather than deny grace.

activation_trace.role: Matching recompense anchors the focus's limit to what they did.
Work pay supplies the strict ledger qualified by later gifts.
A later party catching those ahead supplies relational addition.
Non-diminution preserves workers' accounts while addition occurs.
Acquisition through effort supplies individual accountability.
Collateral held against a right gives liability a secured-account form.
Release without exchange supplies a gratuitous countercurrent to wage equivalence.
Mercy supplies benefit not necessarily exhausted by earned return.

structural_cues: 52:21 coordinates joining descendants, no reduction of work, and collateralization by acquisition.
52:27-28 names favor, protection, beneficence, and mercy after recalled fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preserved accounts, relational joining, release without exchange, and mercy; I infer bounded punitive equivalence with surplus gift. All favor may instead be reward for prior faith.

changed_reading.before: Every outcome is exhausted by exact work-for-pay exchange.
changed_reading.after: The focus limits punitive return to one's work while context permits protected, relational, and unpriced surplus.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plotting reverses agent and patient within 52:42 and later has no power to avail. Against the focus's snare branch, intentional work and matching recompense describe a trap assembled by plotters whose closure returns upon them.

activation_trace.role: Snares and traps supply the focus's secondary capture image.
Matching return ties the reversal to what the agents initiated.
Intentional work supplies the agents' construction of the setup.
Plotting supplies both the attempted device and, through reversal, its return on the plotters.
The same plot lacks rescuing efficacy, closing the trap against escape.

structural_cues: 52:42 repeats the plot root while reversing who controls whom.
52:46 states that their plot avails nothing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrivance, reversal, non-availing, intentional work, and matching return; I infer that their plot helps close the snare. An externally imposed counter-plot remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The trap is a static enclosure imposed from outside.
changed_reading.after: It becomes reflexive: intentional plotting helps assemble the snare whose requital closes on its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same self-restraint is commanded at 52:48 in relation to judgment and under care, while at 52:16 patience and non-patience are equal after entry. Patience is phase-dependent: before closure it sustains fidelity; after sentence it cannot reopen adjudication.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the outcome-invariant response after entry.
Equality marks its lack of leverage in the focus phase.
The same restraint is positively commanded before completion, preserving its value.
Adjudication supplies the process whose timing separates waiting from concluded sentence.
Watchful preservation supplies the environment where patience remains active fidelity.

structural_cues: 52:16 places the response pair after fire-entry; 52:48 places patience before or during judgment.
52:48 joins patience to protective oversight and repeated glorification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated patience in opposite frames, adjudication, care, and sequence; I infer a before/after-closure distinction. Constant moral value but no punitive mitigation remains compatible.

changed_reading.before: The focus appears to make patience itself worthless.
changed_reading.after: It says only that patience cannot renegotiate a closed sentence; under ongoing judgment and care the same restraint remains meaningful.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant split mapping of the recompense root into shearing and harvest, not its ordinary branch. It remains anchored at word 9 and gains coherence from explicit intentional work and past accumulation. Render only as a secondary image of consequences coming ripe and being cut off, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 9-12 join the split-mapped recompense root to a completed work history.

activation_trace.role: Season and readiness for harvest supply consequences reaching due time.
A cut-off fleece supplies accrued output separated from its producer.
Intentional work supplies cultivation-like activity whose yield matures.
Past predication supplies accumulation before harvest.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an abstract return after action.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, past work ripens into a harvest now cut and handed back to its producers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: A remote nominal branch of the patience root is a white layered cloud, while the focus uses endurance verbs. It remains anchored through the exact repeated root and 52:44's falling sky-fragment misnamed as a cloud piled layer on layer. Render as an imagistic resonance about delay and misclassification, not the lexical meaning of either patience verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled patience root at words 2 and 5 is activated by the piled-cloud scene of 52:44.

activation_trace.role: A white layered cloud supplies the remote focus-root image activated later.
A detached piece of body or sky supplies the actual falling object.
Downward falling supplies its threatening direction despite the label.
Cloud supplies the observers' benign category for what descends.
Layering things atop one another activates the stacked-cloud image.

changed_reading.before: Patience and refusal are only psychological reactions after entry.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, patience brushes against cloud-stacking: waiting and relabeling can pile appearances but cannot alter what falls.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates the prayer branch of the focus root whose syntax clearly concerns fire, then sets it against glorification on rising and at night. It remains anchored in the focus root's fire/prayer plurality and explicit worship at 52:48-49. Render only as dark structural juxtaposition or anti-rite; never translate the imperative as prayer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 carries fire-contact and worship branches while the surah closes with patience and repeated worship commands.

activation_trace.role: Being made to enter fire fixes the immediate punitive sense.
Binding ritual worship supplies the remote branch enabling anti-ritual contrast.
Worship through glorification supplies the protected addressee's commanded rite.
Bodily rising supplies a posture and slot for worship.
Repeated night worship extends the rite across time against forced fire-entry.

changed_reading.before: The imperative is only a command to undergo fire.
changed_reading.after: Without changing that sense, it takes a grim command-shaped counter-position to patient rising and worship: forced fire-entry as anti-rite.

strongest_changes: Non-deflection and force narrow equality to outcome-changing efficacy rather than erasing the difference between patience and refusal.
The positive work-history formula at 52:19 makes the focus one half of a reward/punishment mirror.
Relational joining, collateral, gratuitous release, and mercy keep personal liability coexistent with surplus gift.
The patience command at 52:48 makes patience phase-dependent: meaningful under ongoing judgment, unable to reopen sentence after entry.
Plot reversal strengthens the trap model, while 52:44 keeps a stranger patience/cloud resonance alive without promoting it to translation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus behaves as a hinge rather than a single maxim. Its roots sustain judicial, economic, material, temporal, and entrapment mechanisms, and context changes their scope without selecting one winner. The most diagnostic surprises are the split-root harvest, the piled cloud activating a remote patience branch, and fire/prayer plurality against closing worship.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening written objects may authorize judgment generally rather than encode a personal deed ledger.
Positive gifts may all be rewards for prior faith, weakening but not erasing the grace-beyond-wage model.
Fire-straightening, harvested work, clouded patience, and anti-rite are branch resonances, not replacement lexical senses.
The boundary between closed sentence and the period where patience remains efficacious is inferred from sequence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Patience stripped of agency.** `ص ب ر` B001 is self-restraint from panic; `س و ي` B001 makes the two responses equivalent. By contrast, 52:48 commands patience while judgment is still unfolding; I supply restraint after closure -> no changed outcome, restraint before closure -> faithful agency. Patience is context-dependent.
2. **No substitution in recompense.** `ج ز ي` B001 is return matching an act, while B002 is standing in for another. `إِنَّمَا` and the work-clause select matching return and block proxy; I supply past act -> equivalent consequence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 52:21 preserved individual pledge even during family reunion, confirming that mercy does not erase personal earning.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Failed Repulsion Becomes Forced Conveyance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Defenders cannot push the event away and are instead violently driven, like a rebuked herd, into the fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: repulsion and defense `quranic:root_000480:B001/m01`; violent shove `quranic:root_000477:B001/m01`; herding call and rebuke `quranic:root_000477:B003/m01`; entering or meeting fire `quranic:root_000880:B003/m01`; kindled fire `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The direction of force reverses. The attempt to repel punishment becomes the condition of being driven toward it, and the repeated shove acquires the concrete rhythm of moving a resistant herd.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bu dalı, ayakta durma, belden eğilme, yere kapanma, yakarış ve yüceltme gibi belirli bölümleri olan yükümlü tapınma olarak açıkça tanımlar. Bu nedenle dal, yalın bir iyilik dileğinden ve kökün öteki anlamlarından ayrı tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca belirli kuralları ve beden hareketleri olan tapınmayı kapsar; yalın yakarışı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimin özel tapınma anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve başka yapılara bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Ayakta durma, belden eğilme ve yere kapanma gibi belirli bölümlerle yerine getirilen, sınırları konmuş yükümlü bir tapınmadır.

facets.statement: Belirli beden duruşları, yakarış ve yüceltme içeren özel ve yükümlü tapınmadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bu eylemin belirli kuralları bulunan ve ayakta durma, eğilme ile yere kapanmayı içeren özel bir tapınma oluşudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli beden hareketleriyle yerine getirilen özel ve yükümlü tapınmanın bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, anlamın eylemi yapana göre değiştiğini açıkça gösterir: insanlar başkaları için iyilik diler, göksel görevliler bağışlanma diler, Tanrı ise esirger, över ve aklar. Dalın çok katmanlı çerçevesi bu katılımcı ayrımını doğru biçimde taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal belirli beden hareketleri olan tapınmayı değil, yöneltilmiş dilek, övgü, esirgeme ve aklamayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın anlam ile kime yöneltildiği ve kime yüklendiği belirli yapılara bağlı anlamlar ayrı katmanlar halinde tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkası için iyilik dileme anlamındadır; eylemi yapana göre bağışlanma dileme, esirgeme, övme ya da aklama biçimini alır.

facets.statement: İnsan sözünde bir başkasına yöneltilen iyilik dileği ve güzel anmadır.
Göksel görevlilere yüklendiğinde iyilik ve bağışlanma dileme anlamına gelir.
Tanrı'ya yüklendiğinde esirgeme, övme ve aklama anlamına gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, başkasına yönelen iyilik dileğini temel alır ve konuşan özneye göre bağışlanma dileme, esirgeme, övme ya da aklama yönlerinin öne çıktığını belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü ateşe girme, ateşte kalma, ısısını ve şiddetini çekme ile birini ateşe sokma ilişkilerini birlikte destekler; benzer biçimde ağır bir duruma uğrama da buna bağlı bir uzantıdır. Dal, ateşle nesne pişirme veya düzeltme eyleminden ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam ateş ya da ateşe benzetilen ağır durumla kurulan yapılara bağlıdır; yalın ve sınırsız bir kök anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca ateş, ısı veya benzetilen ağır durumla kurulan yapılara bağlanır ve yalın köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşe girip onda kalmak, ısısını ve şiddetini çekmek ya da bir başkasını ateşe sokmaktır; benzetmeli kullanımda ağır bir durumun sıkıntısını çekmeyi anlatır.

facets.statement: Ateşe girmek, onda kalmak ve yakıcı şiddetine uğramaktır.
Bir başkasını ateşe sokup bu şiddete uğratmaktır.
Ateşe benzetilen ağır bir işin veya kötülüğün sıkıntısını çekmektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ateşin içine girme, onda kalma ve yakıcı şiddetini çekme çekirdeğinde birleşir; ettirgen kullanım bir başkasını ateşe sokar, benzetmeli kullanım ise ağır sıkıntıya uğramayı anlatır.

concept_gloss.text: ateşin veya benzer bir sıkıntının şiddetine uğramak; birini ateşe sokmak
concept_gloss.applicability: Ateşle kurulan edilgen, ettirgen ve benzetmeli yapıların ortak anlam alanını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Ateşe girme, şiddetini çekme, başkasını ateşe sokma ve ağır sıkıntı uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin ateşe girdiği, onda kaldığı veya yandığı doğrudan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ateşle doğrudan karşılaşmayı, içinde kalmayı ve yakıcı şiddeti çekmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ateş benzetmesiyle ağır bir işin veya kötülüğün çekildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yakıcı şiddetin ağır sıkıntıya aktarılan benzetmeli uzantısını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onun sertliğini ve gücünü göze alamamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, ateşte kalmayı ve birini ateşe sokmayı ayrı katılımcı yönleriyle belirginleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yakıtı, ateş yakmayı ve ateşte yiyecek pişirmeyi de aynı geniş alan içinde toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ateşle karşılaşmayı, yakıcı sıcaklığı çekmeyi ve bundan doğan ağır durumu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ateşin şiddetine uğrayan veya uğratılan katılımcıya bağlı yapılardır; komşu dal ise ateşin yakıt ve pişirme işlevlerini de kapsadığı için daha geniştir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü ateşi canlandıran yakıtı, ateşte pişmiş yiyeceği, eti ateşte pişirmeyi ve değneği ateş üzerinde döndürerek düzeltmeyi açıkça bir araya getirir. Bunlar ateşin şiddetine uğramaktan farklı olarak ateşten yararlanılan nesne ve işlemlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın yakıt ve pişmiş yiyecek adları, eti pişirme ve değneği düzeltme yapılarından ayrı facetler olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yakıt ve pişmiş yiyecek anlamlarını, belirli nesnelerle kurulan pişirme ve düzeltme eylemlerinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Yalın biçimlerde ateşi tutuşturan yakıtı veya ateşte pişmiş yiyeceği gösterir; belirli yapılarda eti ateşte pişirmeyi ve değneği ateş üstünde döndürerek yumuşatıp doğrultmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Ateşi tutuşturmak ve sürdürmek için kullanılan yakıt ya da ateşin kendisidir.
Eti ateşte pişirme eylemi ve ateşte pişmiş yiyecektir.
Bir değneği ateş üzerinde döndürerek yumuşatıp düzeltme işlemidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, ateşi besleyen yakıtı ve ateşten yararlanarak yiyecek pişirme ya da değnek düzeltme işlemlerini kapsar; ateşe uğrayan kişinin yaşantısını anlatmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sırtın orta bölgesini, kuyruk dibinin iki yanını ve kuyruk sokumu çevresini aynı beden alanında toplar. Doğumda bu bölgenin açılması veya yavrunun buraya inmesi, beden bölümünün kendisine bağlı özel durumlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Beden bölümü çekirdektir; doğum sırasında açılma ve yavrunun bu bölgeye inmesi ona bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ateşin sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı, ateş yanında ısınmayı, bir şeyi ateşle pişirip yakmayı, ateşe atmayı, yakacağı ve zorluğa katlanma aktarımını birlikte doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ateşle doğrudan karşılaşma çekirdektir; pişirme, yakma, düzeltme, yakacak ve zorluğa katlanma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerin ateş ve yakacak anlamlarını korurken yalnız belirli kuruluşlarda görülen ısınma, düzeltme ve zorluğa katlanma anlamlarını genelleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşin içine girerek ya da yanında bulunarak onun yakıcı sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı anlatır; ateşte eti pişirme ile değneği ateşte yumuşatıp düzeltme gibi ateşle işleme anlamları belirli kuruluşlara bağlıdır. Ateşi besleyen yakacak adı ile bir işin ağır sıkıntısını çekme anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık ateşe girer, ateşin yanında kalır veya onun yakıcı sıcaklığını ve şiddetini çeker.
Kişi ateşin yanında durarak onun sıcaklığıyla ısınır.
Belirli kuruluşlarda et ateşte pişirilir veya değnek ateşte yumuşatılıp düzeltilir.
Ad biçimi ateşi tutuşturup sürdürmeye yarayan yakacağı, ayrıca ateşte pişirme işini belirtebilir.
Ateşin yakıcılığı, bir işin ağırlığını ve sıkıntısını çekmeye aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, ateşin sıcaklığını çekme ve ateşle işleme çekirdeğini; ısınma, pişirme, yakma, değnek düzeltme, yakacak ve ağır bir işe katlanma yönleriyle genişletir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi geniş bir dövme taşını, üzerinde güzel kokulu maddelerin veya kurutulmuş yemişin dövülmesini ve taşın kaba, kalın bir levha görünümünü açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, malzemenin üstünde dövüldüğü geniş taş yüzeyidir; genel olarak her taş veya her dövme aracı kastedilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın taş adlarıyla sınırlıdır; ateş, tapınma, anatomi veya yalnız başka bir araçta görülen dövme anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Güzel kokulu maddeler veya kurutulmuş yemiş gibi malzemelerin üzerinde dövüldüğü geniş, kalın ve kaba taş yüzeyidir.

facets.statement: Geniş ve sert bir taş, malzemenin üstünde dövülüp ezildiği çalışma yüzeyi olarak kullanılır.
Taşın üzerinde güzel kokulu maddeler veya kurutulmuş yemiş dövülebilir.
Nesne kaba ve kalın bir taş levha görünümüyle de betimlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, üzerinde malzeme dövülen geniş taşı tanımlar; güzel kokulu madde ve kurutulmuş yemiş örneklerini verir ve taşın kaba, kalın yüzeyini belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Malzemenin içine değil üstüne konup dövüldüğü geniş, sert ve çoğu kez kaba taş yüzeyi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş taş yüzeyini, malzemenin onun üstünde dövülmesini ve araç işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güzel kokulu madde, kurutulmuş yemiş veya benzeri malzemenin üstünde ezildiği taş araç için doğal kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Taşın malzemeyi dövüp ezmeye ayrılmış bir çalışma yüzeyi olmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güzel kokulu madde veya kurutulmuş yemiş gibi malzemelerin üstünde dövüldüğü geniş ve kaba taşı tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu karttaki kaba ve geniş nesne benzetmesi, odak kaynağındaki kalın taş levha betiminden doğar ve temel sınırı değiştirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Malzemenin üstünde dövüldüğü geniş ve çoğunlukla düz bir taş yüzeyidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Malzemenin içine konarak dövüldüğü çukur kap biçimli aracı veya bazı anlatımlarda döven aracı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir malzemeyi vurarak ezme ve inceltme işinde kullanılan araçları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal geniş taşın üst yüzeyini çalışma alanı yapar; komşu dal ise çoğunlukla malzemenin içine konduğu kap biçimli bir dövme aracıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tam eşleşen dal ve sık karışabilecek havan karşılaştırması yayımlandı; diğer adaylar yalnız geniş taş, sert taş veya belirli bir maddeyi dövme alanını paylaşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصلاية والصلاءة وهي حجر عريض أو فهر يدق عليه العطر أو الهبيد
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس النار ولا الصلاة ولا الصَّلا من الظهر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصلاية الفهر (sihah); الصلاءة بالهمز مثله (sihah); الصلاية كل حجر عريض يدق عليه عطر أو هبيد (tahdhib); الصلاية سريحة خشنة غليظة من القف (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iri bir başak veya kamış başına benzeyen tepe taşıyan bitkiyi ve develerin onu otlaması nedeniyle verilen deve yiyeceği benzetmesini doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirli bitki çekirdektir; develerin onu otlaması ve bu bitkinin yetiştiği arazi adı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim belirli bitkiyi adlandırır; o bitkinin bulunduğu arazi anlamı yalnız ilgili ad kuruluşuyla sınırlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kamış başına benzeyen iri bir başak veya tepe taşıyan ve develerin otladığı belirli bir bitkidir. Bu bitkinin yetiştiği araziyi belirten ad, bitki çekirdeğine bağlı bir yer kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli bitki, kamış başına benzeyen iri bir başak veya belirgin bir tepe taşır.
Bitki develer tarafından otlanır ve onların yiyeceği sayılacak kadar bu hayvanlarla ilişkilendirilir.
Bu bitkinin yetiştiği arazi, bitkinin varlığına göre ayrıca adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım iri başaklı veya tepeli belirli bir bitkiyi tanımlar, kamış başına benzeyen görünüşünü belirtir ve develerin onu otlamasıyla kurulan yiyecek ilişkisini aktarır.

concept_gloss.text: iri başaklı, develerin otladığı bir bitki
concept_gloss.applicability: Kamış başına benzeyen iri başağı veya tepesiyle ayırt edilen ve deve yemi olan belirli bitkiyi betimleyerek karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin ayırt edici iri başağını ve develer tarafından otlanma özelliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Arazinin söz konusu iri başaklı bitkiyi taşımasına göre adlandırıldığı yer bildiren kuruluşta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Arazi ile orada yetişen belirli bitki arasındaki varlık ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bitkinin kendisini, iri başaklı görünüşünü ve deve yemi oluşunu doğrudan adlandırmaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iri başaklı, develerin otladığı bir bitki

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da iri başağı veya tepesi bulunan, develerin otladığı ve onların yiyeceği sayılan aynı bitkiyi tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Sunulan kartlarda bitkinin görünüşü, otlayan hayvan veya kullanım kapsamı bakımından anlamlı bir sınır farkı yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tam eşleşen komşu dal yayımlandı; diğer adaylar deve yemi, otlak veya benzer görünümlü bitki alanını paylaşır ancak aynı bitkiyi göstermez.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصليان وهو نبت له سنمة أو سبطة عظيمة وتسمية العرب له خبزة الإبل

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı, kişinin sarsıntı ve yakınma karşısında kendini tutması, aklın ve doğru sayılan davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kalması olarak kurar. Bu yüzden ruhsal dayanma ile zorla alıkoyma, öldürme, güvence verme ve somut nesne adları birbirinden ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal içsel özdenetim ve dayanıklılıkla sınırlıdır; dışarıdan zorla tutma ya da özel kalıp anlamları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca genel özdenetim ve dayanma çekirdeğini verir, kalıba bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Sarsıntı, sıkıntı ya da istenmeyen bir durum karşısında kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyması ve doğru bildiği tutumu kararlılıkla sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Kişi, sarsıntı ve yakınma dürtüsüne karşı kendini tutar.
Bu kendini tutma, aklın ve doğru davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kararlı kalmayı içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı sarsıntının karşıtı olan, kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyup gereken tutumda kalmasını sağlayan bir özdenetim olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tepkiyi denetleyip doğru görülen tutumu sürdürme çekirdeğinin tamamı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kendini tutmayı hem de güçlük karşısında kararlı kalmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntı veya yıkım karşısında taşkın tepki vermeden dirençli kalmayı anlatan bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Güçlük karşısında sağlam ve denetimli kalma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Aklın ya da doğru davranışın gerektirdiği her durumda kendini tutma kapsamını daraltır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; supplied roster içindeki adaylardan hiçbiri genel özdenetim sınırını ek bir karşılaştırmayla keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبر بوصفه حبس النفس وثباتها على ما يقتضيه العقل والشرع، وضده الجزع والجبن والضجر بحسب الموضع.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قتل الصبر ولا يمين الصبر ولا الكفالة ولا أسماء النبات والحجارة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصبر نقيض الجزع (ayn;jamhara;tahdhib)؛ الصبر حبس النفس عن الجزع (sihah)؛ صبرت نفسي أي حبستها (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ حبس النفس على ما يقتضيه العقل والشرع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ortak çekirdeği dışarıdan uygulanan zorlama ve alıkoyma olarak verir; bunun ölüm gerçekleşene kadar tutma ve yönetici önünde ant içmeye zorlama biçimleri vardır. Bu çerçeve içsel dayanma anlamından ve ödeşme cezasının bağımsız hukuki amacından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal zorlayıcı alıkoymayı, öldürülmek üzere tutmayı ve yönetici önünde ant içmeye zorlamayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; genel zorla tutma ile öldürme ve ant içirme kalıpları ayrı yüzlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlıyı kaçamayacağı biçimde zorla tutmak; özel kullanımlarda onu öldürülene kadar bağlı bırakmak ya da yetkili önünde ant içmeye zorlamaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da canlı dışarıdan uygulanan güçle alıkonur ve çıkışı engellenir.
Öldürme kullanımında canlı, ölüm gerçekleşene kadar bağlı ya da tutulmuş durumda bırakılır.
Ant içme kullanımında kişi, yetkili makam önünde ağır bir ant vermeye zorlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zorla alıkoyma çekirdeğini, öldürülmek üzere tutulan canlıyı ve yetkili önünde ant içmeye mecbur bırakılan kişiyi kapsayacak biçimde sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel zorlama çekirdeği ile ölüm ve ant bağlamındaki özel gerçekleşmeleri birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dış güçle tutmayı ve kişinin serbestçe çıkamamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın ya da başka bir canlının ölüm gerçekleşene kadar kaçamayacağı biçimde tutulduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorla tutma ile ölüm sonucuna yönelen özel süreci korur.
error_profile.loses: Ant içmeye zorlama kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetkili önünde kişinin ant verene kadar alıkonduğu ya da baskı gördüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama ve ant verme katılımcılarını korur.
error_profile.loses: Öldürülmek üzere tutma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın çekirdeği, ölüm ya da ant için uygulanan zorlayıcı alıkoymadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın çekirdeği, bir suçun karşılığı olarak öldürme yetkisinin uygulanmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yetki, ölüm ve zor kullanma senaryosunda yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öldürme öncesindeki bağlı tutma biçimini adlandırır; komşu dal ise önceki bir öldürmeye karşılık verilen hukuki öldürme işlemini adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana anlamı bir başkası için maddi yükü üstlenen güvence verici kişidir. Topluluğun işlerinde onunla birlikte bulunan kişi kullanımı bununla ilişkili olsa da aynı hukuki yükümlülüğü zorunlu olarak taşımaz; bu nedenle ana anlamdan bağımlı bir uzantı olarak ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Güvence verip yük üstlenme çekirdektir; topluluğun işlerine eşlik eden kişi bununla eşitlenmeyen ilişkili bir kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım güvence verme çekirdeğini kurar ve topluluğa eşlik etme kullanımını bağımlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasının yükümlülüğünü yerine getireceğine güvence vererek doğabilecek yükü üstlenen kişidir. Topluluğun işlerinde onun yanında duran kişi için de ilişkili biçimde kullanılır.

facets.statement: Kişi, bir başkasının yükümlülüğü için güvence verir ve doğabilecek maddi yükü üstlenir.
İlişkili kullanım, bir topluluğun işlerinde onunla birlikte bulunan kişiyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir başkası için güvence verip yük üstlenen kişiyi merkeze alır; ayrıca topluluğun işlerinde yanında bulunan kişiyi ilişkili bir kullanım olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir başkasının borç ya da yükümlülüğünü üstlenme çekirdeği için kullanılır; eşlik eden kişi uzantısını tek başına karşılamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının yükümlülüğüne güvence verme ve yükü üstlenme çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Topluluğun işlerinde onun yanında bulunan kişi uzantısını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hukuki güvence vermekten çok topluluğun işlerine sürekli katılan kişiyi anlatan ilişkili kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Toplulukla birlikte bulunma ve onun işleriyle ilgilenme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Maddi yükümlülüğe güvence verme çekirdeğini içermez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبير بمعنى الكفيل، وصبرت بفلان إذا كفلت به، وما قرب منه من صبير القوم الذي يكون معهم في أمورهم.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin üst bölümünü ya da yan sınırını, kap ve mezar gibi nesnelerin çevre yanlarını açıkça birlikte verir. Dolma anlatımı bu yan ya da üst sınıra kadar ulaşmayı bildirir; taş ve çakıllı arazi anlamları bu mekânsal parçadan ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir nesnenin üst veya yan sınır bölümüdür; kalın taş ve çakıllı yer anlamları buna dahil değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; genel üst ve yan bölüm çekirdeği, kap ve mezar özelleşmeleri ile sınıra kadar dolma kalıbından ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin üst bölümü ya da yan sınırıdır; kap ve mezarın çevre yanlarını da belirtir. Kalıba bağlı kullanımda bir kabın bu sınıra kadar dolmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün üstteki bölümü veya yan sınırı belirtilir.
Kap ve mezar söz konusu olduğunda bunların çevre yanları belirtilir.
Dolma kalıbında içerik kabın üst ya da yan sınırına kadar ulaşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin üstünü veya yanını, kap ve mezarın çevre yanlarını ve doluluğun bu sınıra ulaşmasını aynı mekânsal bölüm çevresinde toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem üst bölüm hem de yan sınır seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kabın içeriğinin üst sınırına kadar ulaştığını anlatan dolma kalıbında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İçeriğin kabın üst sınırına ulaşması sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel yan bölüm ile mezar çevresi kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üst ya da yan sınırına kadar

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğal yükseltilerin belirli bölümleriyle ilişkilendirilebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sert ve kalın taşları, çakıllı araziyi ve katı kaya ya da taşlık alanı belirten sınırlı bir adı birlikte verir. Bunlar üst veya yan bölüm anlamından ayrılır; ağır sıkıntı anlatımı ise bu dalın somut taş ve arazi değerine alınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sert taş ve taşlı zemin alanındadır; mekânsal üst bölüm ile mecazlaşmış ağır sıkıntı anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; taş ve çakıllı arazi yüzleri ile belirli taşlık yer adı birbirine karıştırılmadan tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Sert, kalın ya da düz taş ve bu tür taşların bulunduğu çakıllı veya yüksekçe arazidir; belirli bir kullanımda katı kaya ya da taşlık alanı adlandırır.

facets.statement: Sert, kalın veya düz taşlar belirtilir.
Taş niteliği, çakıllı ya da kaba ve yüksekçe araziyi adlandıracak biçimde genişler.
Sınırlı bir adlandırma katı kaya yüzeyini veya taşlık alanı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sert ve kalın taşları, taşların oluşturduğu çakıllı araziyi ve katı kaya ya da taşlık alanı belirten özel kullanımı aynı somut alan içinde verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taşların fiziksel niteliğini ve bu taşlarla kaplı zemin uzantısını birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Sert taşı ve taşlı araziye genişleyen somut alanı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek tek taşlardan çok zeminin çakıllı niteliğinin anlatıldığı arazi bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Tek bir sert ya da kalın taşı belirtme imkanını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi savaş, ağır yıkım ve çıkış yolu bulunmayan büyük iş gibi durumları belirli adlandırmalarla anlatır. Çekirdek yalnızca zorluk değil, içine düşülen durumun ağır ve kaçışsız oluşudur; somut kaya veya arazi göndergesi bu dala alınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli adlandırmalara bağlı ağır ve çıkışsız durumu kapsar; somut taşlık yer ile yalnızca soğuk şiddeti kapsam dışıdır.

concept_map.definition: Belirli adlandırmalarda, bir topluluğun içine düştüğü savaş, büyük yıkım ya da çıkış yolu bulunmayan ağır durumdur.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da topluluk ağır ve büyük bir durumun içine düşer.
